value.name: codicil is filed and sealed
value.description: The courier from the register's office arrives and leaves with the codicil sealed into its docket, formalizing the document's filing.
evidence: By the time the courier from the register's office had come and gone with the codicil sealed into its docket

value.name: afternoon settles after the dispute
value.description: The tense afternoon in the sitting room gives way to a quieter mood that feels like a partial defeat rather than a victory.
evidence: the long afternoon in the sitting room had thinned into something quieter than victory

value.name: Daniel asserts his position
value.description: Daniel declares his ground in the dispute before yielding to the pressure of the evidence.

value.name: attorney drafts withdrawal
value.description: After seeing Rosa's sworn page and the journal, Daniel allows his attorney to write the withdrawal in the kitchen.
evidence: under the weight of Rosa's sworn page and the journal beside it, had let his attorney write the withdrawal in the kitchen with a borrowed pen

value.name: buyers' hold expires
value.description: The buyers' hold lapses because no one moves to extend it.
evidence: the buyers' hold expired without anyone moving to extend it

value.name: Lucia escorts Asha to the door
value.description: Lucia walks Asha to the threshold and keeps hold of her sleeve as she offers her supper.
evidence: Lucia walked Asha to the door with the brass key still warm in her palm and did not quite let go of her sleeve at the threshold

value.name: Asha realizes her role has changed
value.description: Standing outside after the door closes, Asha recognizes that she has become more than just the lawyer in the house.
evidence: Asha stood on the stoop a moment after the door closed
how thoroughly she had stopped being only the lawyer in that house

value.name: Asha discovers missed calls and voicemail
value.description: On the train home, Asha checks her phone and finds missed calls and a voicemail from her father's care facility.
evidence: Her phone, when she finally looked at it on the train home, held four missed calls from her father's care facility in Trenton and a voicemail from the night nurse

value.name: night nurse reports father's fall
value.description: The voicemail explains that Asha's father fell getting out of bed, is bruised but oriented, and needs a discharge decision by Friday.
evidence: the night nurse's careful voice said her father had fallen getting out of bed at shift change, that he was bruised but oriented, and that the discharge planner would need a decision by Friday

value.name: Asha replays the voicemail and checks her calendar
value.description: Asha listens to the message twice and opens her calendar to assess the time she has before Thursday.
